colors.rules: No gradients on dark background surfaces. Depth must be achieved through flat layered dark structural tones (#060814, #0A0E1F, #121833, #1A2247) and delicate 1px borders with varying opacity.

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-normal tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
scale.section_h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-normal tracking-tight leading-[1.15]

preloader.handoff: clip-path mask reveal opening vertically from center to unmask Hero WebGL canvas

custom_cursor.touch_device_behavior: hidden / disabled via pointer-fine media query

reduced_motion.prefers_reduced_motion: Disable GSAP scroll-jacking and horizontal pinning. Render 2D high-resolution canvas poster instead of 3D WebGL shader blob.

three_js_shader_spec.material_type: Custom ShaderMaterial with Simplex 3D Noise + Fresnel Iridescence

uniforms.uScrollVelocity: float - driven by Lenis scroll delta

three_js_shader_spec.interaction: Blob warps vertices along normals based on cursor distance and scroll speed; material shifts iridescent hue along specular rim.

testing_requirements.rule: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scroll and GSAP ScrollTrigger ticker are synced properly using requestAnimationFrame.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Use #0A0E1F for page background and #060814 for preloader/footer surfaces.
Implement magnetic cursor component using Framer Motion spring physics.
Use data-testid on all interactive buttons, links, form fields, cards, and section titles.
Ensure dark theme styles are applied cleanly with high APCA contrast ratios.
